messages:
Eve: Postmortem follow-up: we have a clear recurring chain across recent incidents -> external auth throttles -> model-registry auth failures -> client retry storms + regional stickiness preventing failover. Need concise owners, short timelines, and one clear verification step so these don't remain open.
Maya: agree. let's pick owners and minimal deliverables.
Liam: I'll take vendor outreach and SLA ask. Will open SR and request historical throttle windows and a prioritized contact.
Arjun: I can own the client changes: singleflight token refresh, cap concurrent refreshes, separate handling for 401 vs 429, jittered exponential backoff. ETA: 3 business days.
Tess: I'll own routing config: lower sticky-routing TTL for model-registry flows to 15s and add explicit alternate-region fallback triggered on auth errors. I'll run a 5% canary for 24h. ETA: 6 business days.
Noah: infra will add a synthetic failure job to staging that emits 429 bursts and measures retry rate, queue depth, and tail latency. I can also wire an alert if concurrent refreshes exceed threshold. ETA: 4 business days.
sre-oncall-bot: Follow-up incident created: INC-2028-06-01-224. Reminder set for owners in 48h.
Eve: Proposed action list (lean):
- A1: Arjun -> client PR: singleflight + cap concurrent refreshes to 3, treat 401-> immediate refresh path, 429-> longer backoff with jitter. Deliverable: PR + integration test. Due: 3 business days.
- A2: Liam -> vendor SR: request maintenance windows, historical throttle logs, and prioritized contact. Deliverable: SR + summary. Due: 8 business days.
- A3: Tess -> routing TTL change + canary: lower TTL to 15s for model traffic, 5% canary 24h, rollback criteria defined. Deliverable: rollout doc + telemetry queries. Due: 6 business days.
- A4: Noah -> synthetic job + alert: 429 burst injection job in staging + alert rule when retry rate > 4x baseline or concurrent refreshes > 10. Deliverable: job + alert + runbook. Due: 4 business days.
- A5: Eve -> update postmortem follow-up doc and add a recurring incident card to the dashboard. Deliverable: doc + dashboard link. Due: EOD tomorrow.
Maya: Add a security quick-check: ensure token prefetch/singleflight doesn't extend token lifetime beyond intended scope.
Arjun: quick pseudo for backoff I'll implement:```
// pseudo backoff
base = 150ms
attempt++
if status == 429 {
  wait = (base * 2^attempt) + rand(0, base) + 1200ms // longer for 429s
} else {
  wait = (base * 2^attempt) + rand(0, base)
}
// 401 -> trigger immediate refresh via singleflight, then one quick retry
```
Tess: Canary plan: 5% traffic -> 24h -> monitor p95 latency, token-miss rate, failover activation. Rollback if p95 latency increases > 12% or token-miss rate > 0.7%.
Noah: Synthetic job will emit PASS/FAIL and post SLO drift to #incidents-alerts so we can validate before prod rollout.
Liam: opened SR-99977 with vendor; asked for historical throttle windows and an escalation contact. Will paste replies in the follow-up doc.
Eve: Great. Let's hold chatter here minimal and update the follow-up doc/tickets. I'll create follow-up tickets and link to INC-2028-06-01-224.
Arjun: I'll post PR link in the follow-up doc when ready.
Tess: I'll draft the rollout doc and include exact telemetry queries and rollback steps.
Noah: I'll publish the synthetic job runbook and alert thresholds to the doc.
Eve: Can we do a 30m check-in in 48h to confirm progress?
Eve: @deploy-bot please schedule a check-in for 48h.
deploy-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Vendor Dependency Mitigation Check" Thu Jun 03 11:00am PT. Invite sent to Eve, Maya, Liam, Arjun, Tess, Noah.
sre-oncall-bot: Reminder: A1 due in 3 business days.
Maya: Thanks all. We'll reconvene at the check-in; update the follow-up doc instead of posting updates here. :thumbsup:
Liam: I'll paste vendor reply in the doc when available.
Arjun: noted, will keep PR updates in the doc.
Tess: closing loop here; using the follow-up doc for changes.
Eve: Closing thread for now. We'll reopen in the check-in if needed.
